question: If $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is defined by $f(x) = 2x + 3$ and $g: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ by $g(x) = 5x - 1$, then $g(f(x))$ is:
explanation:
Compute the composition $g(f(x))$.

First substitute $f(x)=2x+3$ into $g(x)$.

$g(f(x))=g(2x+3)=5(2x+3)-1$.

Simplifying gives $10x+15-1=10x+14$.
